gitCommit.subject: privacy policy 1.1: the deletion paragraph says email-assisted deletion at launch
gitCommit.body:
privacy policy 1.1: the deletion paragraph says email-assisted deletion at launch

Owner, 2026-11-05: the privacy policy said deletion "is confirmed with a
code sent to your verified WhatsApp number", which is not yet true while
code delivery is unavailable. The owner's wording, EN/FR/AR, replaces that
paragraph: the in-app flow and, when available, the WhatsApp code; else
support@ verifies identity and authority, processes the request under the
account-deletion policy and confirms completion. Version 1.1, effective
2026-11-04 (the build's VITE_LEGAL_EFFECTIVE_DATE).

Tests: privacy and account deletion are 1.1, the other four texts 1.0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
